1244|245cbd71.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
1244|245cbd71.text:
The roots and ferns speak well of you, small one. Although I have many names, I answer to few. But you may call me Rethiel.

And you must harken... for these lands weep from festered wounds, and I would charge you to heal them.

1571|c5ceacbe.name: Shellei Brondir
1571|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

1573|10cfc531.name: Gryth Thurden
1573|10cfc531.text: The Wildhammer dwarves might have fast steeds, but can those Aerie Peak gryphons stand the heat of The Great Forge?  I think not!

2104|fe329646.name: Captain Stoutfist
2104|fe329646.text: Menethil Harbor enjoys a bit of peace these days, thanks to the mountaineers.  But we must be ever watchful of new threats from our enemies.

2277|985afd1f.name: Loremaster Dibbs
2277|985afd1f.text: Hello, $N! What can I do for you?

2432|c5ceacbe.name: Darla Harris
2432|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

270637|3e0b4d08.name: Howin Kindfeather
270637|3e0b4d08.text: So many Wildhammer lives lost... whole families erased...

2835|c5ceacbe.name: Cedrik Prose
2835|c5ceacbe.text: Where would you like to fly to?

2916|427db4a9.name: Historian Karnik
2916|427db4a9.text: Welcome to the Explorer's League.  If you need information, and it is in book form, then I might be able to help you out.

352|4946c28b.name: Dungar Longdrink
352|4946c28b.text: Where is it ye would like to go lad? For just a few coin my Gryphons can get ye there faster than even the swiftest horse.

6491|22357dc5.name: Spirit Healer
6491|22357dc5.text: It is not yet your time. I shall aid your journey back to the realm of the living... for a price.

277-progress.name: Rethiel the Greenwarden
277-progress.text: Do you have the Gnolls' tools for fire?
277-progress.title: Fire Taboo

335-progress.name: Zardeth of the Black Claw
335-progress.text: Wishock will soon garner enough support to cause us much grief.  Were you able to obtain the Tear of Tilloa or Musquash Root yet?
335-progress.title: A Noble Brew

336-progress.name: Lord Baurles K. Wishock
336-progress.text:
Can you not see that I am busy?  My words must be heard!  I am very important to the future of this Kingdom!

Oh... what have you there?  Why it looks like a refreshing drink...
336-progress.title: A Noble Brew

637-progress.name: Sara Balloo
637-progress.text: You look as though you have traveled a great distance and seen much turmoil in your time, $c.  These times we live in are trying on the soul.  What news do you bring to me now?
637-progress.title: Sully Balloo's Letter

683-progress.name: King Magni Bronzebeard
683-progress.text:
So you are $N the $c? News of your contributions to the Alliance has traveled quite far, you know?

On what business do you come before me today?
683-progress.title: Sara Balloo's Plea

689-progress.name: Grand Mason Marblesten
689-progress.text: $N, $N, $N! Tell me you have enough Alterac Granite for me to begin my masterpiece in honor of Sully Balloo.
689-progress.title: A King's Tribute

88757-complete.name: Essene Villard
88757-complete.text:
You got my book! And my waterskin! And my necklace! Oh, good fortune finds me today... thank you so much.

I'd better make sure everything is intact!
88757-complete.title: Accessories of the Lost

88757-progress.name: Essene Villard
88757-progress.text: Just relacing my boots! Any luck getting past those Dark Irons and finding my things?
88757-progress.title: Accessories of the Lost

98223-progress.name: Captain Stoutfist
98223-progress.text: I can practically hear the cries of the Dragonmaw from here! They deserve every bit of it and more.
98223-progress.title: Old Habits

98310-complete.name: Prospector Whelgar
98310-complete.text:
By Magni's beard, they're beautiful! Wait a second, do you see that?! Hold the hearts closer to the Goaz Stone for a moment...

<New text reveals itself on the stone in a faint shimmering light.>

Hmm, it's hard to make out. "Curse of Flesh... they will fail." What's that supposed to mean?!

We've got to get this somewhere safe so we can study it further!
98310-complete.title: Gleaning Our Future

98310-progress.name: Prospector Whelgar
98310-progress.text: Be careful out there. I suspect these constructs will be tougher than the warder was.
98310-progress.title: Gleaning Our Future

98313-accept.name: Prospector Whelgar
98313-accept.text:
Whatever this is all about, $N, it's epic stuff alright.

I'll bundle everything up nice for you. Take it to Historian Karnik in the Hall of Explorers in Ironforge. You'll usually find him in the back, nose-deep in some tome or another in the library.

It'll take a downright army to crack the case on this one, but if what we've seen so far is any indication it will well be worth it!
98313-accept.title: For Further Study

98313-complete.name: Historian Karnik
98313-complete.text:
Well I'll be...

This is a lot to go through! Very exciting, though. VERY exciting!

It'll take me some time to even put a plan together on this one. Come back another time and I can give you the latest. For now, please accept the thanks of the Explorers' League.
98313-complete.title: For Further Study

98313-progress.name: Historian Karnik
98313-progress.text: Apologies, I'm terribly, terribly busy. Did you need something?
98313-progress.title: For Further Study
